resources.string: Record one sample, compare five encodings. This separate test app does not change your keyboard or its settings.
One recording is encoded as WAV, Opus 64/128/200 kbps and AAC 128 kbps. Nothing is uploaded until you tap “Recognize variants”. Recordings are temporary; save the ZIP before closing the app.
Read this at a natural pace (about 30 seconds), or dictate your own text:

Next Friday we are flying to Dubai and staying at Nikki Beach Hotel. Please check the reservation for Alexander Sullivan: two adults, three nights, breakfast included. We need an airport transfer at seven thirty. If the room is not ready, we will leave our luggage and visit Abu Dhabi. Send the confirmation on Telegram, and check whether we can move our departure from November twenty-third to November twenty-fourth without an extra charge.
Variants ready. You can save them locally or recognize them below.
Recording stopped because the app left the foreground. Start a new sample.
Microphone permission is needed to record. Grant it in Android app settings if it was previously denied.
API key (used only for this test; not saved)
Audio language code, e.g. en or ru
Optional reference transcript for counting word errors
Not sent to the provider. For the reading sample, copy the text above.

Recognition sends one request per available variant to the endpoint below. Uses your API key. Post-processing and recent context are off. The ZIP includes audio, transcripts and test settings, but never your API key.
HTTP is unencrypted: your key and recordings can be intercepted. Use only for your own server on a trusted network.
Comparison complete. Save the ZIP to share the results.
Enter an API key to recognize. Local recording and ZIP export work without a key.
Enter an http(s) audio/transcriptions endpoint. Chat Completions is not supported by this test.
Encoding comparison uses one PCM source. It does not reproduce every detail of normal MediaRecorder capture. One sample cannot establish general recognition accuracy.
